categories.main_business_segments: LIFEDRINK COMPANY, INC. operates primarily in the manufacturing and sales of beverages (soft drinks) and tea leaves. The group consists of the parent company and two consolidated subsidiaries, focusing on the 'Drink & Leaf' business as a single segment, with an emphasis on in-house production of bottled water, tea beverages, and carbonated drinks.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a business model centered on limited product variety and mass production, in-house integration from raw material procurement to sales, and a nationwide network of factories. Key production methods include in-house PET bottle molding, tea leaf roasting, beverage filling, and packaging, enabling cost reduction, quality control, and stable supply.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Major customers are large-scale retailers such as general merchandise stores, food supermarkets, discount stores, drugstores, and home centers, to whom the company supplies both private label and its own branded products. The company also targets consumers directly through e-commerce channels, including its own online store and major e-commerce platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Japan, with production facilities spanning from Iwate to Miyazaki Prefecture, ensuring nationwide coverage. All sales and assets are domestic, with no significant overseas business reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: LIFEDRINK COMPANY operates primarily as a midstream and downstream player, handling beverage and tea leaf manufacturing, packaging, and direct sales to retailers and end consumers. The company also internalizes much of its supply chain, from raw material procurement to final product distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maximizing production and sales capacity ('Max Production Max Sales'), cost reduction and productivity improvement through automation and logistics optimization, expansion of e-commerce and D2C channels, quality enhancement, and active use of M&A for capacity and market expansion. Sustainability initiatives focus on human capital, water resource management, eco-friendly packaging, and resilient logistics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of beverages and tea products to retailers (both private label and branded), as well as direct-to-consumer sales via e-commerce platforms. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery of goods to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include major national beverage manufacturers and regional/local beverage producers. LIFEDRINK COMPANY positions itself as a cost leader, offering high-quality, low-priced, and stable supply, with scale advantages over local competitors and price competitiveness against large national brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached 44.5 billion yen (up 16.5% year-on-year), with operating profit of 4.7 billion yen and net income attributable to parent company shareholders of 3.4 billion yen. The company has demonstrated strong growth, with sales and profits increasing steadily over recent years, and a workforce of 715 employees as of March 2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high quality, low price, and stable, large-scale supply as its core value proposition. Its differentiation lies in mass production of a limited product range, full in-house integration, and a nationwide factory network, enabling reliable, cost-effective supply to major retailers and adaptability to consumer trends such as e-commerce.
